verdict.rationale: Insomnia's AI features include commit message suggestions generated from the user's own project changes, and AI-assisted mock server generation from prompts, OpenAPI definitions, or live URL responses. Both are AI suggestions grounded in user data, but they are narrow, task-specific generators rather than general insights. Missing for 10: AI analysis of request/response or test data, AI-generated insights or recommendations about APIs or specs, in-depth docs on how the suggestions work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
